# data/processed

This directory contains processed outputs derived from the raw ICNF ground truth and Sentinel-2 tile metadata.

---

## icnf_fires_t29tpg_2025.csv

ICNF 2025 burned area records clipped to Sentinel-2 tile T29TPG and exported with English column names.

**Source:** `data/shapefiles/ground_truth_ICNF/ardida_2025.shp`
**Generated by:** Hannah Nathanson
**Method:**
- Clipped to T29TPG tile boundary using `sentinel2_tiles_PT_terra_tm06.shp`
- All 22 columns renamed from Portuguese to English
- `Causa_Tipo` and `Causa_Desc` categorical values translated to English
- Geometry column dropped for tabular export

**Result:** 182 fire events, 13,035 ha total burned area

| Column | Original | Description |
|---|---|---|
| fire_id_sgif | Cod_SGIF | SGIF national fire identifier |
| fire_id_anepc | Cod_ANEPC | ANEPC incident identifier |
| year | Ano | Year of fire |
| datetime_start | DH_Inicio | Fire start datetime |
| datetime_first_intervention | DH_1Interv | First intervention datetime |
| datetime_end | DH_Fim | Fire end datetime |
| duration_min | Duracao_m | Fire duration in minutes |
| dicofre_code | PI_DICOFRE | Administrative division code |
| nuts3_region | PI_NUTS3 | NUTS III region |
| district | PI_Distrit | District |
| municipality | PI_Conc | Municipality |
| parish | PI_Freg | Parish (freguesia) |
| locality | PI_Local | Locality |
| cause_code | Causa_Cod | Cause code |
| cause_type | Causa_Tipo | Cause type (Negligent / Intentional / Natural / Unknown / Rekindling) |
| cause_description | Causa_Desc | Detailed cause description |
| area_ha_sig | AreaHaSIG | Total burned area (ha) from GIS |
| area_ha_sgif | AreaHaSGIF | Total burned area (ha) from SGIF |
| area_ha_forest | AreaHaPov | Forest burned area (ha) |
| area_ha_scrub | AreaHaMato | Scrubland burned area (ha) |
| area_ha_agricultural | AreaHaAgri | Agricultural burned area (ha) |
| edition | Edicao | Dataset edition |

## icnf_burned_labels_t29tpg_2025.tif

Binary burned area label raster aligned to the T29TPG Sentinel-2 chip grid.

**Source:** `data/shapefiles/ground_truth_ICNF/ardida_2025.shp`
**Generated by:** Hannah Nathanson
**Method:**
- Clipped to T29TPG tile boundary and reprojected to EPSG:32629
- 1-pixel (10 m) interior erosion applied to each polygon before rasterisation to remove boundary label ambiguity (see `documents/evaluation_protocol.md`, Section 3.2)
- Rasterized at 10 m resolution over the full tile extent

**Raster properties:**

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| CRS | EPSG:32629 (UTM Zone 29N) |
| Resolution | 10 m |
| Dimensions | 10980 x 6304 px |
| Extent | left=600000, right=709800, bottom=4590240, top=4653280 |
| Encoding | 1 = burned, 0 = background, 255 = nodata |
| Burned pixels | 1,203,059 (12,031 ha, 1.74% of tile) |
| Compression | LZW |
| File size | 1.2 MB |

The 8% area reduction relative to the raw shapefile (13,035 ha) is expected and attributable to boundary erosion removing perimeter pixels with mixed land cover.
